details:
Sometimes, after I have been online and restart the game, VRChat becomes stuck indefinitely on the connecting screen.

My avatar appears to load into the selected world correctly. Other users can see me and talk to me, but I remain stuck on the connecting screen and cannot interact with the world or anyone in it. From my side, my avatar does not initialize at all, and my parameters do not load for other users.

Closing and restarting VRChat does not reliably fix the issue. It often takes several attempts.

A couple of times, I have been able to bypass the problem by launching directly into a world using a world link from VRCX or the VRChat website. During the most recent occurrences, direct launching had the same problem and also required repeated attempts.

After several failed launch attempts, Easy Anti-Cheat eventually displays an error claiming that it does not trust a seemingly unrelated file. The files it flags are generally ordinary drivers, including unsigned (But well known unharmful) drivers, located under C:\Windows\System32.

I have individually verified each flagged file by comparing its hash / ran scans to confirm that it is legitimate and not malware masquerading as a system driver.

The most recent example was:

Untrusted system file

(\\?\GLOBALROOT\Device\HarddiskVolume10\Windows\System32\atidxx64.dll)

After EAC displays this error, VRChat starts normally on the next attempt. This has happened every time the issue has occurred.

There are currently no clear steps to reproduce it consistently, but I have logs available if they would be useful.

Troubleshooting already attempted:

Restarted the computer

Reinstalled VRChat

Confirmed that at least two other users have experienced the same issue

Tried launching normally

Tried launching directly into a world through VRCX, fresh and non-fresh instances

Tried launching directly into a world through the VRChat website

It is important to note that this has only happened while using PCVR on the Unity 6 branch. Desktop mode and Steam Deck have otherwise worked normally.

I have not attempted a clean Windows installation, since multiple other users have also encountered the same behaviour.

w_2026.3.1-a5d694378a - Steam Branch: Unity-6
title: Restarting the game can cause an endless connecting screen until EAC flags a system driver
